name: zotify
title: Zotify
description: See what's playing at your dining hall, request songs on Rockbot, and vote on the queue, with Zotify.
author: itmadden

commands.name: queue
commands.title: Zotify Queue
commands.description: See what's playing and what's next at a dining hall, and search for songs to request.

commands.name: now-playing
commands.title: Zotify Now Playing
commands.description: Show the song playing at your dining hall in the menu bar, with the queue in its menu.

preferences.name: showTitle
preferences.title: Menu Bar
preferences.description: Show the playing song's title next to the icon.
preferences.label: Show Song Title

commands.name: add-song
commands.title: Add Song to Zotify
commands.description: Search for a song to request at your dining hall.

preferences.name: adminTools
preferences.title: Admin Tools
preferences.description: For a school's admins: ask for the admin scope when signing in, to downvote and rearrange Zotify's queue. Log out and back in after changing it.
preferences.label: I'm a Zotify admin

preferences.name: personalAccessToken
preferences.title: Personal Access Token
preferences.description: Instead of signing in, use a token from zotify.app/developers. Give it the music:read and music:write scopes.
